text: Two men are stranded. Water, but zero food. Who lasts longer?
Body fat is stored food: about thirty-five hundred calories per pound.
A lean man has about twenty pounds of fat: that's roughly two months.
A big man can have a hundred pounds: many months!
But the body also burns muscle, even the heart.
The record? A Scottish man fasted three hundred eighty-two days, with doctors watching.
Fat isn't just weight. It's a backup tank.
